kr8 0.4.3 for Android — open your boards from the phone.

- New Canvas tab: every space that has board pictures, your community's Home board first, with when each was last updated. Tap one to open it full screen and pinch to zoom.
- Each space's canvas button shows a dot when that space has board pictures, and explains what to do when it doesn't.
- Boards appear once kr8 on your computer is on 0.4.5 or later.
